# awscc_appconfig_experiment_definition (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::AppConfig::ExperimentDefinition



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_identifier` (String) The application ID, name, or ARN.
- `audience_rule` (String) Rule expression defining the experiment audience.
- `configuration_profile_identifier` (String) The configuration profile ID, name, or ARN.
- `control` (Attributes) The control (baseline) variant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control))
- `environment_identifier` (String) The environment ID, name, or ARN.
- `flag_key` (String) The key of the existing flag in the configuration profile to experiment on.
- `name` (String) A name for the experiment definition.
- `treatments` (Attributes List) Treatment variants (1-5). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--treatments))

### Optional

- `audience_description` (String) Human-readable description of the audience.
- `hypothesis` (String) The hypothesis of the experiment.
- `launch_criteria` (String) Criteria for launching the experiment.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to associate with the experiment definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) The resolved application ID (read-only, assigned by service).
- `created_at` (String) ISO-8601 creation timestamp.
- `experiment_definition_id` (String) The experiment definition ID.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) Current status.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO-8601 last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appconfig_experiment_definition.example
  identity = {
    application_id = "application_id"
    id             = "id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `application_id` (String) The resolved application ID (read-only, assigned by service)
- `id` (String) The experiment definition ID

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appconfig_experiment_definition.example
  id = "application_id|id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_appconfig_experiment_definition.example "application_id|id"
```
